{{Quote|You were right. Positive ID on the captain. Experiment chamber 21.|Legat to Dust|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Legat''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Galactic War]].<ref name="TOR" /> Around [[3641 BBY]]<ref name="Time" /> he was on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]], where he was bribed by the [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[Dust (Abyssin)|Dust]] to aid him in finding and eliminating the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] known as the [[Voidhound]]. Legat found the Voidhound in [[Experiment chamber 21|Experiment Chamber 21]] conversing with a [[Rattataki/Legends|Rattataki]] prisoner called [[Sraja]] and relayed their location to Dust. The [[Abyssin/Legends|Abyssin]] killed Sraja with one headshot and together he and Legat attempted to kill the smuggler, though both were defeated.<ref name="TOR" />
